mapper.select: SELECT R.EMBRYO_CODE, R.BOM_DATA_VERSION EMBRYO_VERSION, CI.CORD_SPEC, CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE1, CI.SIDEWALL_LENGTH, CI.ID, CI.PRODUCTION_STAGE FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT R LEFT JOIN T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI ON R.EMBRYO_CODE = CI.EMBRYO_CODE AND R.BOM_DATA_VERSION = CI.EMBRYO_VERSION AND CI.DEL_FLAG = '0' WHERE R.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate} AND R.DEL_FLAG = '0'
select param_code, param_value from T_CD90_PARAMS where DEL_FLAG = '0'
SELECT MAX(BATCH_NO) BATCH_NO FROM T_CD90_AUTO_SCHEDULE_RECORD WHERE schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into T_CD90_AUTO_SCHEDULE_RECORD (ID, CX_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, STATUS, SCHEDULE_DATE, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, DEL_FLAG) values (SEQ_AUTO_SCHEDULE_RECORD.Nextval, #{cxBatchNo}, #{batchNo}, #{status}, #{scheduleDate}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{delFlag})

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM T_CD90_SCHEDULE_RESULT R WHERE R.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND R.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate}
SELECT * FROM T_CD90_ASSIST_SPEC R WHERE R.DEL_FLAG = '0'
mapper.delete: UPDATE T_CD90_ASSIST_SCHEDULE SET DEL_FLAG = '1' WHERE SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate}
